_tentang: English strings for docs/index.html. Keys are the exact Indonesian strings used by scripts/buat-halaman.ts. A missing key falls back to the Indonesian text, so this file can grow gradually. Case IDs are identifiers used by docs/hasil-uji.md: only their Indonesian descriptive parts are translated, and the English table keeps the original ID in a title tooltip for traceability. Untranslated-looking IDs (K01, Runut Cepat ...) are deliberate proper names and codes.
